coordinate_evidence.repeat_geometry_substitute_rejected: Using a 2.5 mm reconstruction for missing 1.25 mm original geometry is not justified: 6 of 65 matched LUNG pairs have different in-plane geometry.
coordinate_evidence.source_header_conflict: Official XLS header says top-left, but the three official CT illustrations show the listed y value counted from the bottom. One global Rows-1-y correction was frozen before model training.
coordinate_evidence.zero_based_index_assumption: The spreadsheet does not specify zero versus one based x/y; zero based was prespecified globally.

selection_policy.coordinates: Global Y correction top_y = originalRows-1-XLSy (zero based), established from official XLS embedded examples; original LUNG pixel -> physical patient position -> selected CT grid; no SEG pixels used.
selection_policy.extra_acquisitions: Prefer earliest date with eligible same-day pair, then earliest two AcquisitionTimes; if dates differ retain earliest2 distinct date/time tuples and explicitly flag; tieSeriesNumber thenUID.
selection_policy.physical_z_priority: Use official XLS physical z, even when its image-number cross-check conflicts; record mismatch explicitly. This rule is independent of SEG and model outcomes.
selection_policy.primary_reconstruction: 1.25mm LUNG with explicit SEG ReferencedSeriesUID matching CT; both earliest same-day distinct acquisitions. If fewer than2 available, use1.25mm STANDARD for both acquisitions.
source_header_text: Location of a voxel around the lesion center (origin: top-left)
